_README: SAMPLE ONLY: 14 of ~77,000 indexed projects, chosen to demonstrate the accounting traps documented in docs/. Regenerate the full set with: npm run index -- --emit-bulk
demonstrates: retired generation at 100 bps with a 50/50 split (vs 125 bps / 75-25 on legacy+current)
vault-held buyback tokens that a dead-address-only indexer would report as zero
composite {generation}:{launchId} keys; launchId alone collides across factories

_STALE_CONFIDENCE_DISCLOSURE.inCurrentCode: confidence: "medium", with a note stating the assumption
_STALE_CONFIDENCE_DISCLOSURE.why: These records were generated on 2026-09-13T17:38:28.126Z, before the confidence downgrade. They have deliberately NOT been hand-edited or regenerated: rewriting generated output by hand would make this sample a fabrication rather than a record of a real run.
_STALE_CONFIDENCE_DISCLOSURE.whatChanged: The arithmetic is unchanged and remains balanceOf(0x...dEaD) + balanceOf(creatorVault). Only the stated confidence changed. The sum is exact, but attributing the entire vault balance to buyback origin is an assumption: no mechanism was identified that prevents an unrelated inbound transfer to a vault, and after graduation transfersUnlocked() is true, so any holder can send the launch token to any address including the vault.
_STALE_CONFIDENCE_DISCLOSURE.howToReadThisSample: Treat totalSupplyCommittedToBurnWei here as an UPPER BOUND on supply committed to burn, not a measured quantity, exactly as a current run would tell you via confidence and note. See docs/known-limitations.md section 8.

_SAMPLE_IS_HISTORICAL.why: These are real records from a real run on 2026-09-13. They were NOT regenerated for the 2026-09-17 validation run, because the committed sample is a curated 14-record selection chosen to demonstrate specific accounting traps, and no script in this repository reproduces that selection. Regenerating it would have meant hand-authoring the selection, which is worse than shipping a clearly labelled historical sample.
_SAMPLE_IS_HISTORICAL.howToRead: Use this sample to understand the RECORD SHAPE and the provenance model. Do not use its totals as current: the chain is live and has produced roughly 19,000 more launches since. See the 'Latest validation run' section of README.md, or re-run the indexer.
